crossRefs.note: Jesus said to him, “Most certainly I tell you that tonight, before the rooster crows, you will deny me three times.”
Then he began to curse and to swear, “I don’t know the man!” Immediately the rooster crowed.
Jesus said to him, “Most certainly I tell you, that you today, even this night, before the rooster crows twice, you…
But he began to curse, and to swear, “I don’t know this man of whom you speak!”
The rooster crowed the second time. Peter remembered the word, how that Jesus said to him, “Before the rooster crows…
Jesus answered him, “Will you lay down your life for me? Most certainly I tell you, the rooster won’t crow until you…
Peter therefore denied it again, and immediately the rooster crowed.

people.name: Peter
people.line: Apostle of Jesus, leader in the early church

translations.web: He said, “I tell you, Peter, the rooster will by no means crow today until you deny that you know me three times.”
translations.bsb: But Jesus replied, “I tell you, Peter, the rooster will not crow today until you have denied three times that you know Me.”
translations.kjv: And he said, I tell thee, Peter, the cock shall not crow this day, before that thou shalt thrice deny that thou knowest me.
translations.asv: And he said, I tell thee, Peter, the cock shall not crow this day, until thou shalt thrice deny that thou knowest me.
